purpose: Price sensitivity: preserved or reversed cheapest set
must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
selection_rule: First case: first candidate with a +/-1-cent edit preserving the entire cheapest set. Second case: first noncheapest candidate set one cent below the minimum.
applicability: Complete current prices, positive cent-valued alternative inside development bounds; otherwise skip.

must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
selection_rule: Toggle the lexicographically first candidate with a known flag.
applicability: At least one known current flag.

purpose: Household-history sensitivity including dependent purchase-offer relations
must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
selection_rule: First support ID; replace purchase with next candidate in sorted cyclic candidate order.
applicability: Known support purchase and at least two candidates.
regenerate: counts, shares, most frequent, historical price and advertising relationships

purpose: Change price-purchase association at fixed purchase counts
must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
selection_rule: Enumerate vector permutations; deduplicate unordered visible records; maximize absolute change in purchased-among-cheapest numerator, then lexicographic assignment.
applicability: 2..8 complete support records; changed association with same eligible denominator; otherwise uninformative.
regenerate: per-record cheapest/gaps and historical price aggregates

purpose: Change advertisement-purchase association at fixed purchases
must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
selection_rule: Enumerate vector permutations; deduplicate unordered visible records; maximize absolute change in purchased-advertised numerator, then lexicographic assignment.
applicability: 2..8 known support records with varying flag vectors and changed association; otherwise skip.

purpose: Remove historical offer context while retaining purchases
must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
selection_rule: Set all historical offer values to null; retain support IDs and purchases.
applicability: At least one provided historical offer field.
regenerate: all historical offer relationships and exclusions; counts preserved

must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
selection_rule: Rotate candidate presentation one position left; preserve answer mapping.
regenerate: all compact facts rerendered in presentation order

purpose: Answer-label assignment sensitivity, decoded by product
must_remain_fixed: Every source/presentation field outside the permitted set
selection_rule: Rotate sorted answer identifiers one position left across fixed product identities; remap every current/support candidate field.
applicability: At least two candidates; bijection verified.
regenerate: all compact facts regenerated under consistent relabeling
